Lucia Fernandez  
Zurich, Switzerland | +41 79 123 45 67 | lucia.fernandez@cybersecureinc.com | linkedin.com/in/luciafernandez | github.com/luciafernandez  

Master of Science in Data Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), 2021  
Focused on machine learning applications in cybersecurity, with coursework in statistical modeling, distributed systems, and ethical hacking. Graduated with distinction, leveraging academic projects to prototype anomaly detection frameworks that later informed industry deployments.  

Professional Experience  
CyberSecure Inc., Machine Learning Engineer – Cybersecurity Threat Detection (2022–present)  
Architected a real-time threat detection system processing 10M+ network events daily, achieving an F1 score of 85% in identifying sophisticated attack vectors. Spearheaded model deployment on AWS SageMaker, maintaining 99.99% uptime through rigorous monitoring and auto-scaling. Optimized cloud cost structures by 22% via spot instance utilization and reserved instance planning, ensuring scalable infrastructure for global enterprise clients.  

CyberSecure Inc., Junior ML Engineer (2021–2022)  
Developed NLP pipelines for phishing email classification, integrating transformer-based models to reduce false positives by 37% while improving recall by 19%. Engineered ensemble models combining scikit-learn and PyTorch for threat scoring, which became the foundation for the company’s core detection engine.  

SentinelTech Security, Data Analyst Intern (2020–2021)  
Constructed predictive models for anomaly detection in network traffic, achieving 92% precision in identifying zero-day threats. Collaborated on a project using Apache Airflow to automate data pipelines, reducing manual intervention by 40% and enabling real-time analysis of 500GB+ of security logs weekly.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Specialized in deploying machine learning models for cybersecurity applications, with hands-on experience in:  
- **NLP**: Built transformer-based classifiers for phishing detection, achieving 94% accuracy in distinguishing malicious from benign emails.  
- **AWS**: Led infrastructure for model deployment, integrating MLflow for experiment tracking and W&B for hyperparameter tuning, reducing deployment cycles by 30%.  
- **MLOps**: Automated model retraining workflows using Airflow, ensuring compliance with enterprise security protocols and minimizing downtime during updates.  
- **Cloud Cost Optimization**: Designed cost-effective architectures for real-time threat detection, balancing compute resources and storage costs across EU and US regions.  
- **Docker/Kubernetes**: Containerized ML models for production environments, enabling seamless scaling and version control across 15+ microservices.  
- **Model Deployment**: Transitioned models from research to production, leveraging Terraform for infrastructure-as-code and ensuring reproducibility with CI/CD pipelines.  
- **TensorFlow/PyTorch**: Developed custom architectures for time-series anomaly detection, achieving 91% F1 score in identifying ransomware patterns.  
- **scikit-learn**: Implemented baseline models for threat scoring, later replaced by deep learning approaches that improved detection rates by 28%.  

Projects / Side Projects  
- **Real-Time Threat Detection System**: Built scalable pipeline using AWS Lambda and Kinesis, processing 10M+ events/hour with 85% F1 score.  
- **Phishing Email Classifier**: Trained BERT-based model on 100k+ email samples, achieving 94% accuracy and 92% precision in production.  
- **Cost-Optimized ML Inference**: Reduced EC2 costs by 25% through spot instance scheduling, while maintaining 99.95% latency targets for critical security alerts.
